scope: Complete new source-facts/export/report code and changed mutation/preview/save paths, independently challenged by requirements reviewer. This is not a full source-pixel or production-account acceptance claim.

findings.problem: A confirmed coffee save followed by a stale or unavailable state refresh closed the form and discarded the imported-detail correction handoff.
findings.repair: Retain submitted details, identify the exact acknowledged library entry, and retry reading the original save without another add mutation. Build correction forms only from saved records/revisions.

findings.problem: An account change between an inner awaited session guard and its caller continuation could return the previous account receipt.
findings.repair: Capture owner and epoch across the full mutation/add operation, validate the queued owner, and check again after awaits and before UI/receipt handoff. Account reset clears pending reviews.

findings.problem: Hundreds of early supplementary dialog labels could fill the collector before later selected-product evidence reached priority sorting.
findings.repair: Reserve primary text early and use a bounded priority-aware intermediate collector. Keep explicit truncation and existing final size limits.

findings.problem: Null or scalar optional purchase variants threw before other valid evidence could be returned.
findings.repair: Skip malformed variants in the human summary while preserving their bounded exact raw JSON in the review export.

findings.problem: UTF-16 chunk boundaries split emoji pairs, producing exports the local helper could not encode.
findings.repair: Use code-point-safe text/JSON/export boundaries, verify complete JSON reconstruction, and reject invalid lone surrogates explicitly in the separate local helper.

findings.problem: Image alt/title captions were pre-clipped at1601characters without truncation disclosure and continuation priority could invert chunk order.
findings.repair: Pass bounded complete captions through the ordinary chunker and preserve continuation order.

findings.problem: Identical structured fragments from different source URLs or parts were deduplicated, losing original capture attribution.
findings.repair: Include exact source URL and part in structured evidence identity, and retain the original JSON pointer.

findings.problem: A complete approved catalog could permanently hide newer page facts from URL preview.
findings.repair: Add an explicit Check Current Roaster Page action using the ordinary authenticated bounded lookup, quota and cooldown. Default catalog/warm-cache paths remain available.

findings.problem: Strict benchmark normalization could erase numeric qualifiers and accidentally accept >1600m as1600m.
findings.repair: Preserve numeric qualifiers, decimals, ranges and ratios; recompute both baseline and candidate comparisons using the same normalization. No oracle edits.

findings.problem: Comparison/report joins and supplementary display needed stronger bindings to original case identity, frozen assertions and exact replay bytes.
findings.repair: Verify complete unique case sets, source URL/roaster identity, oracle/manifest hashes, replay fingerprints/hashes, archived packet hashes, and indexed supplementary assertion identity before report generation.

findings.problem: Large purchase records repeated identical image and presentation values, displacing original prices, options and quantity rules.
findings.repair: Decompose exact public records into typed projections, original child paths and explicit same-source references. Prioritize commerce cores and exact endpoint option definitions; keep size bounds and truncation explicit.

findings.problem: Long selected Woo variation-form attributes were cut off by a general structural attribute bound, and hidden forms or different query-selected products could be misattributed.
findings.repair: Read only bounded selected numeric product forms with matching origin/path and meaningful query selectors. Reject hidden/CSS-hidden ancestors, inconsistent duplicate forms, noncurrent actions, false remote-variation markers and private form properties.

findings.problem: Reference records could survive after their targets were displaced by preview limits.
findings.repair: Require a complete contiguous parseable JSON target in the same exact URL and product-form locator namespace. Remove dangling references and disclose truncation.

findings.problem: Deduplicating identical prose lost the endpoint that independently supported it; terminal caption colons consumed separate slots for identical facts.
findings.repair: Retain bounded explicit supporting-source pairs. Text deduplication preserves semantic field, section, source path and form locator; only a terminal caption colon is treated as equivalent punctuation. Structured namespaces remain exact.

findings.problem: Selected public metadata, general coffee FAQs and literal map-marker values were absent or displaced.
findings.repair: Retain allowlisted page descriptions, bounded visible coffee guidance with explicit general scope, and literal bounded map-marker data. Do not infer canonical facts from those sources or fetch linked resources.

findings.problem: The exact-source purchase/export audit did not account for projected values, original HTML form namespaces, or duplicated text attribution.
findings.repair: Validate reconstruction against the frozen original typed value at its exact pointer. Require full cardinality, complete fragments, exact namespaces and explicit supporting-source attribution; do not upgrade strict canonical scores.

findings.problem: Yearless harvest windows and generic lot categories could be mistaken for distinct release identity, including values prefixed with a colon.
findings.repair: Share bounded recurring-window/generic-lot predicates between extraction and verification. Preserve source-only harvest/lot-type details; require independently supported dated, named or numbered release proof.

findings.problem: New audit-integrity regressions were outside the normal Node test glob.
findings.repair: Include tests/audit/*.test.mjs in the existing npm test command, without new dependencies or running hosted workflows.

cost_boundary: No new API keys, paid services, hosted CI, production deployment, SQL or real member writes. Local fixtures and selected public captures only.
integration: No remote audit commit, branch or PR. GitHub tree write was rejected; do not claim integrated or deployed.
